name: ai-chat
description: Курс: AI-чат на NestJS + PostgreSQL + TypeORM (монорепо: apps/api, apps/web, infra, course)

scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
